text:
Sanjay P.: quick async standup — gateway / routing / rate limits
Sanjay P.: what I did: pushed updated rate-limit policy to staging and kicked off a smoke run.
Sanjay P.: blocker: saw 403s from canary traffic, seems like header-based route matcher missed legacy header.
Sanjay P.: today: open a small patch to matcher + open PR to gate canary, watching metrics.

Emily R.: can you paste the failing request/response snippet?

Sanjay P.: sure — pasted from the gateway log:
```
[2026-03-17T15:02:11Z] req_id=abc123 route=prod-v1 matched=false headers={"x-user":"alice"} matcher expects header: x-rd-user => 403
curl -i -H "x-user: alice" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/foo
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n{"error":"route_not_found"}
```

Emily R.: ah — matcher uses `header("x-rd-user")` now. we have a backward-compatibility gap. i can patch to check either header.

Kevin L.: pinging @Maria K. for a quick review once PR is up; also FYI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/2345

Maria K.: will take a look after standup (~10:30 PT). quick note: in staging I saw a burst causing retries to spike; quota calc might need a tweak. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: gateway-config-2026-03-17-2310 — target: 5% traffic, window: 20m

Sanjay P.: question — i changed default token bucket to 100req/min for the new policy. should canary use a lower cap (e.g. 60) to avoid noise?

Emily R.: yes, keep canary conservative. set canary limit to 60 and add a short TTL for burst allowance. also adding a quick alert:
```
alert: gateway_rate_limit_violations
expr: sum(rate(gateway_rate_limit_violations_total[1m])) > 5
for: 2m
notify: #eng-sre
```

Kevin L.: i'll hold merge until Maria gives LGTM. plan to watch the alert and schedule rollback if violations spike > 10/min.

Maria K.: LGTM with one nit (commented inline). no blockers from infra side. :thumbsup:

Sanjay P.: thanks team — i'll patch the matcher + update canary limits, then request merge. i'll post metric updates here as the canary runs.

Emily R.: sounds good. i'll keep an eye on traces and CORS logs.

Kevin L.: thx — ping me if we need immediate rollback.

Sanjay P.: update: 10m in, violations=1, latency stable. continuing to monitor.
